messages:
alex: FYI opened PR to migrate kv-cache dashboard preset and tracing examples across SDKs — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1987. Need quick cycle on code samples + one-liner for changelog. @marie @ben

marie: on it, will check Node & Python snippets

ben: noted — watch out: runtime renamed kv_cache.enabled -> kvCache.enabled in telemetry export. examples that call trace.set('kv_cache', ...) need rename.

alex: exact diff is small, example below:

```yaml
dashboard_preset:
  name: kv-cache-latency
  metrics:
    - kvCache.hit_rate
    - kvCache.latency_p50
```

alex: I also updated trace hook example to use new trace.context helper in SDKs instead of manual headers. Need someone to sanity-check Go snippet.

jamie: I'll run the Go snippet locally, ping me the preview URL

deploy-bot: deploy preview for PR #1987 succeeded: https://deploy-previews.redwood.dev/1987

marie: quick nits: Python example needs async context manager import change, link to tracehook API should point to /sdk/tracehook not /tracing. I'll push a tiny commit.

ben: also add a note in migration guide about cost/latency breakdown key rename (cost_pair -> cost.breakdown) — ops asked for clarity

alex: can one of you grab ownership for this doc? we need a docs owner for followups and redirect patch. I can shepherd but prefer docs owner

marie: I can be owner for the migration doc

ben: I'll own the SDK snippet updates

alex: thanks — moving to review. tagging @sre-team for visibility :eyes:

sre-team: ack — will watch for any runtime compatibility issues during rollout

alex: leaving a final checklist: 1) update Node/Python/Go snippets 2) update internal links 3) add migration note for cost key 4) merge PR and monitor telemetry

marie: done 1/4, pushing commit

ben: done 2/4 & 3/4

alex: thx everyone :tada:
